description:
Configure per-token trading caps (TradingLimit) on the caller's agent wallet.

limits: a list of {token_address, max_position_size?, max_single_trade?,
daily_volume_limit?} objects, USD amounts (> 0, up to 6 decimals). Upserts
by token_address; only the cap keys you include are written -- an omitted
key keeps its stored value, an explicit null clears it (uncapped). Returns
the full updated set read back from the server, plus ``enforcement``
(which rails read each column today). Pure Django write: unlike
set_wallet_policy there is no Turnkey enclave re-push.

On a Lane 2 wallet, raising or clearing an existing cap is refused
(POLICY_VIOLATION) -- the owner loosens it from their authenticated
session. Tightening always applies.

Permission mode: a configuration write -- allowed in every
permission_mode, observe included (same class as set_wallet_policy).
name: set_trading_limits
